state.background: Fresh final implementation checkpoint for P42-599. The P42-599 slice removes only the T9 assertion that the live tooltip has 12 `[data-tooltip-row=true]` rows. P42-593..598 remain: real chart visibility, area paths, viewport, positive in-viewport path bounding box, real hover, live tooltip visibility, and live total DOM visibility. The existing CustomTooltip CPI unit case receives supplied props and asserts 12 rows via CPI_CATEGORIES length, category keys/order metadata/palette colors, zero and missing/NaN dashes, and total 1.25; a separate existing test pins CPI_CATEGORIES length to 12. An initial E2E attempt with `--project=mobile-pixel` selected zero tests and exited 1 because this spec is not matched by that project; corrected Chromium run passed. Independent diff audit confirms intended P42-599 change and T9 neighboring assertions remain. The broader working tree includes other previously reviewed tooltip work; this request judges only P42-599 scope. Prior plan review `results/plan42/p42-599-plan-jev.json` is valid_as_defined, confidence .92, passProbability .93.
